evals.prompt: I have a script for a 60-second product demo. Break it into a shot list.
evals.expected_output: Should ask for or work from the script content, then produce a shot list using the template (shot #, script line, shot type, camera movement, subject/action, duration, source, notes). Should vary shot types across the list rather than repeating one shot type, and should map shot types to script beats (e.g., screen recording for the demo section, close-up for emphasis).
assertions: Produces a structured shot list with the template fields
Varies shot type across the list
Maps shot type to script beat (hook/demo/CTA etc.)

evals.prompt: Some of these shots will be AI-generated and some will be real screen recordings. How do I keep that organized?
evals.expected_output: Should recommend marking the source explicitly per shot in the shot list, keeping AI-generated shots to b-roll/atmosphere rather than product UI, and noting visual style/mood per shot so generated and filmed/recorded footage match in the edit.
assertions: Restricts AI generation to b-roll, not real UI
Recommends matching visual style/mood across sources
